reasons.suite_lancee: grep -n "^export" game/neon.js; echo "==="; npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "^(✖|ℹ (tests|pass|fail))" ; node --test .scratch/defauts.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E "^(✔|✖|ℹ (tests|pass|fail))" ; node --test .scratch/defauts.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E "^(✔|✖|ℹ)" ; npm test 2>&1 | grep -A4 "✖ flanc gauche: la balle repart\|✖ coin haut gauche\|✖ couture horizontale\|✖ face haute: la balle ressort" | grep -E "✖|AssertionError|devait" | head -20; echo "==PROBE=="; node --test .scratch/defauts.test.js 2>&1 | grep -B1 -A3 "AssertionError" | head -30 ; npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "^(✔|✖|ℹ (tests|pass|fail))" ; npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "^(✔|✖|ℹ|# )" | head -50; echo "==="; npm test 2>&1 | grep -cE "^✖" ; npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "^(✖|ℹ (tests|pass|fail))"; echo "== smoke rapide: paddle diagonal extreme =="; node --input-type=module -e " import { step, createState, ballSpeed, WIDTH, PADDLE_Y, BALL_R } from './game/neon.js'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; // balle en diagonale 45 deg a niveau 8, 50 ms : x traverse la portee du paddle pendant la chute const st = createState(8); st.paddle.x = 272; st.ball = { x: 350, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1, r: BALL_R, vx: ballSpeed(8), vy: ballSpeed(8) }; step(st, 0.05); assert.ok(st.ball.vy < 0, 'la balle doit rebondir sur le paddle meme en diagonale extreme'); console.log('diagonale extreme OK: vy =', st.ball.vy.toFixed(1), ', vx =', st.ball.vx.toFixed(1)); " ; npm test 2>&1 | tail -40 ; rm -rf .scratch && npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "^(✖|ℹ (tests|pass|fail))"; echo "==="; git status --short ; rm .scratch/defauts.test.js && npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "^(✔|✖|ℹ (tests|pass|fail))"
